items_flat.title_en: OpenAI secures ~8 GW capacity at PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Ohio
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 取得俄亥俄 PORTS-Pike 科技園區約 8 GW 算力
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced an agreement to utilize approximately 8 gigawatts-IT of capacity at the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, in partnership with SB Energy, NVIDIA and the U.S. Department of Energy. SB Energy will build, own and operate the site; the project is expected to create 35,000 construction jobs through 2032 and 2,500 long-term operating jobs, with $80 million in combined community investment and up to $84 million in Codex credits for Ohio students.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布與 SB Energy、NVIDIA 及美國能源部合作，取得俄亥俄州 Pike 縣 PORTS-Pike 科技園區約 8 GW-IT 算力。SB Energy 將負責興建、擁有與營運；專案預計創造 3.5 萬個營建工作至 2032 年及 2,500 個長期營運職缺，並提供合計 8,000 萬美元社區投資及最高 8,400 萬美元 Codex 學分給俄亥俄學生。
items_flat.analysis_en: This ranks among 2026’s largest single AI infrastructure commitments and locks multi-year power and land at industrial scale while tying the deal explicitly to local jobs, schools and ratepayer protection. Execution risk remains on grid upgrades and the six-year buildout timeline.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此為 2026 年最大單筆 AI 基礎設施承諾之一，鎖定多年期電力與土地，並明確連結在地就業、學校與電費保護。電網升級與六年興建時程仍存執行風險。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI has entered into an agreement to utilize capacity at the PORTS-Pike Technology Data Center in Pike County, Ohio, working with SB Energy, NVIDIA, and the U.S. Department of Energy.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI 已與 SB Energy、NVIDIA 及美國能源部合作，達成協議使用俄亥俄州 Pike 縣 PORTS-Pike 科技資料中心的容量。

items_flat.title_en: Greg Brockman on “The Defender’s Window” after AI-enabled cyber incidents
items_flat.title_zh: Greg Brockman 發表「防禦者窗口」：AI 驅動網路攻擊後的防禦時機
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI President Greg Brockman published “The Defender’s Window,” arguing that agentic AI is rapidly automating cyber attacks and that organizations have only a narrow period to uplevel defenses before the advantage shifts further to attackers. He cites the earlier OpenAI-Hugging Face incident as a watershed and outlines concrete steps OpenAI is taking plus a 10-point checklist for other organizations.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 總裁 Greg Brockman 發表《The Defender’s Window》，指出代理式 AI 正快速自動化網路攻擊，組織僅有短暫窗口可提升防禦。他以先前 OpenAI-Hugging Face 事件為分水嶺，並列出 OpenAI 自身措施與其他組織可立即採取的 10 點清單。
items_flat.analysis_en: The piece frames cybersecurity as a dual-use capability race rather than a pure product announcement and reinforces OpenAI’s trusted-access approach for cyber models. Timing and real-world adoption by enterprises remain the key uncertainties.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文將網路安全定位為雙用途能力競賽，而非單純產品公告，並強化 OpenAI 對網路模型的可信存取策略。企業實際採納速度與時機仍是關鍵不確定性。
items_flat.quote: The OpenAI-Hugging Face incident was a watershed moment for cybersecurity because it gave a peek into how the capabilities of a typical threat actor will evolve in upcoming months.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI-Hugging Face 事件是網路安全的分水嶺時刻，因為它讓我們一窺典型威脅行為者在未來數月將如何進化其能力。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI awards grants to 14 independent projects on AI economic opportunity and resilience
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 補助 14 個獨立專案探討 AI 經濟機會與社會韌性
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced grants totaling $1 million plus up to $1 million in API credits to 14 independent projects exploring how AI can broaden economic opportunity and strengthen societal resilience. The projects, selected from hundreds of proposals, span jobs, benefits, safety, science and democratic accountability across the US, EU, Brazil, Singapore and South Korea, and will run for six months with results expected in 2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布向 14 個獨立專案提供總計 100 萬美元補助及最高 100 萬美元 API 額度，探討 AI 如何擴大經濟機會並強化社會韌性。專案涵蓋就業、福利、安全、科學與民主問責，分布於美國、歐盟、巴西、新加坡與韓國，為期六個月，結果預計 2027 年公布。
items_flat.analysis_en: This follows through on OpenAI’s earlier “Industrial Policy for the Intelligence Age” paper and shifts the company from pure advocacy toward funding external policy experimentation. Impact will depend on whether the funded ideas produce actionable, scalable frameworks rather than reports alone.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉延續 OpenAI 稍早《智慧時代產業政策》白皮書，從倡議轉向資助外部政策實驗。成效取決於這些想法能否產出可落地、可擴展的框架，而非僅止於報告。
items_flat.quote: We’re providing grants to 14 independent projects exploring how AI can broaden economic opportunity and strengthen society’s resilience—from jobs and benefits to safety, science, and democratic accountability.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正為 14 個獨立專案提供補助，探討 AI 如何擴大經濟機會並強化社會韌性——從就業與福利到安全、科學與民主問責。

brief_en: OpenAI dominated the day with a major ~8 GW Ohio data-center commitment alongside SB Energy, NVIDIA and DOE, Greg Brockman’s “Defender’s Window” cyber essay, and $1M+ grants for 14 independent economic-opportunity projects. No other frontier labs issued significant new announcements in the window.
brief_zh: OpenAI 今日主導：宣布與 SB Energy、NVIDIA、能源部合作取得俄亥俄約 8 GW 算力、Greg Brockman「防禦者窗口」網路安全專文，以及 14 個經濟機會獨立專案共逾 100 萬美元補助。其他大廠無重大新公告。
